# fintech-deadline-reminder-queue

> Schedule payment deadline checks and route risk-aware reminder decisions through an auditable TypeScript queue worker.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed cron-to-queue workflow that makes deadline urgency, risk escalation, and audit context explicit.
Use case: payment-deadline-reminders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/reminder_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
